//MU310 指令可以自行修改   LOVE JOVIAN


==KANGAROO==

booting_state=uci -P /var/state get pega.led.booting_state
get_model=atcli at+cgmm
fw_version=uci -P /var/state get pega.fw.cur_ver
run_mfg_script=manufacture.sh
set_pega_model=fw_setenv pega_model MU310
get_pega_model=fw_printenv -n pega_model
set_wifi_ssid=fw_setenv wifi0_ssid WIFI_SSIDName
get_wifi_ssid=fw_printenv -n wifi0_ssid
set_wifi_pw=fw_setenv wifi0_password 12345678
get_wifi_pw=fw_printenv -n wifi0_password
set_eth_mac=fw_setenv eth0_addr 11:22:33:44:55:66
set_wifi_mac=fw_setenv wifi0_addr 22:33:44:55:66:77
get_eth_mac=fw_printenv -n eth0_addr
get_wifi_mac=fw_printenv -n wifi0_addr
set_hwver=fw_setenv hwver SR3
get_hwver=fw_printenv -n hwver
set_mb_sn=fw_setenv mb_sn MU310_1234
get_mb_sn=fw_printenv -n mb_sn
get_imei=atcli at+gsn
get_fw_ver2=atcli at+cgmr
get_eth_info=ethtool eth0

check_sim=atcli at+cpin?
get_ccid=atcli at+ccid
get_imsi=atcli at+cimi
ledtest_lte_off=/etc/diag.sh ledtest lte_5g_off
ledtest_wifi_off=/etc/diag.sh ledtest wifi_off
ledtest_lte_weak=/etc/diag.sh ledtest lte_5g_weak
ledtest_lte_moderate=/etc/diag.sh ledtest lte_5g_moderate
ledtest_lte_strong=/etc/diag.sh ledtest lte_5g_strong
ledtest_lte_off2=/etc/diag.sh ledtest lte_5g_off
ledtest_wifi_red=/etc/diag.sh ledtest wifi_red
ledtest_wifi_amber=/etc/diag.sh ledtest wifi_amber
ledtest_wifi_green=/etc/diag.sh ledtest wifi_green
ledtest_wifi_off2=/etc/diag.sh ledtest wifi_off
reset_btn_check1=/etc/diag.sh resetBtnStatusGet
reset_btn_check2=/etc/diag.sh resetBtnStatusGet
set_usb_mode=atcli 'AT+QCFG="usbcfg",0x2C7C,0x0801,2,1,1,0,0,1,0'
get_usb_mode=atcli 'AT+QCFG="usbcfg"'
set_mfg_flag=fw_setenv mfg 1
get_mfg_flag=fw_printenv -n mfg








==MB指令==>==
build time=cat /etc/pega_fwinfo
EXIT=exit
Login=root==>oelinux123==>cat /etc/pega_fwinfo

HW_revision=uci -P /var/state show pega.board.model
SW_Firmware_Version=uci -P /var/state show pega.fw.cur_ver
SIM CARD狀態:=uci -c /var/etc show cellstatus.sim.status
5G module 版本號碼:=atcli 'AT+GMM' ==> awk '{if(NR==2){print "module_sku=\047" $1 "\047"}}'
Ethernet_link_speed=ethtool eth0 | grep Speed | awk '{print "ethernet_linkSpeed=\047" $2 "\047"}'
固定IP=ifconfig eth0 192.168.225.1

ping_ip_(IPv4)=ifconfig==>ping 192.168.225.1 -c 4
ping_ip_(IPv6)=ifconfig==>ping -6 fe80::3016:ffff:fe76:6157/64 -c 4

LED signal OFF=echo 0 > /sys/class/leds/signal\:blue/brightness==>echo 0 > /sys/class/leds/signal\:green/brightness==>echo 0 > /sys/class/leds/signal\:red/brightness
LED status OFF=echo 0 > /sys/class/leds/status\:blue/brightness==>echo 0 > /sys/class/leds/status\:red/brightness==>echo 0 > /sys/class/leds/status\:green/brightness

Check signal LED GREEN =echo 255 > /sys/class/leds/signal\:green/brightness==>DELAY:2==>echo 0 > /sys/class/leds/signal\:green/brightness
Check signal LED RED=echo 255 > /sys/class/leds/signal\:red/brightness==>DELAY:2==>echo 0 > /sys/class/leds/signal\:red/brightness
Check signal LED BLUE=echo 255 > /sys/class/leds/signal\:blue/brightness==>DELAY:2==>echo 0 > /sys/class/leds/signal\:blue/brightness

Check status LED GREEN =echo 255 > /sys/class/leds/status\:green/brightness==>DELAY:2==>echo 0 > /sys/class/leds/status\:green/brightness
Check status LED RED=echo 255 > /sys/class/leds/status\:red/brightness==>DELAY:2==>echo 0 > /sys/class/leds/status\:red/brightness
Check status LED BLUE=echo 255 > /sys/class/leds/status\:blue/brightness==>DELAY:2==>echo 0 > /sys/class/leds/status\:blue/brightness

檢查BT=systemctl stop pega-bluetooths==>echo 910 > /sys/class/gpio/exports==>echo out  > /sys/class/gpio/gpio910/directions
檢查BT2=echo 1 > /sys/class/gpio/gpio910/values==>sleep 1s==>rtlbtmp==>sleep 1s
檢查BT3=enable uart:/dev/ttyHS0

設定按鍵=systemctl stop pu_resetBtn_monitor.service==>touch /tmp/MFG==>/usr/sbin/pu_resetBtn_monitor &
檢查按鍵=cat /tmp/reset_button

//指令可以自行修改
